name: devops
description: DevOps (the AIOps pack's DevOps half): Terraform/OpenTofu plan and approved-plan apply, Kubernetes validate/diff/apply/rollout/undo, GitHub Actions runs, failing logs, re-runs and local reproduction, container lint/scan/build, compose deploys with health checks and automatic rollback; gates for IaC, manifests, Dockerfiles, shell, workflows, IaC security and secrets; ship-change, pipeline-fix and k8s-rollout workflows. Tools run in the ops sandbox image (docker/Dockerfile.sandbox-ops); credentials come from the Key Vault.
